column1: # Level-4 exit chain (issue #39). `04_EndLevel.cog` (placed cog 4) ends the level from `pulse:` once
# `endthelevel` is 1 and the 652 sequence armed the pulse.
# 1. The body is placed on the upper floor (sector 643) facing switch surface 5738 and presses use:
#    `04_garage.cog` (placed cog 3) opens garage door thing 19 and sector 650's adjoins.
# 2. The body is placed in sector 636 and walks 636 -> 650 -> 652. 650 (link id 3) sets
#    `endthelevel = 1`; 652 (link id 2) runs the 13.5 s sequence that ends in `setpulse(1)`.
# The second warp lands on the 36-tick sample grid (tick 144), as the gate requires.
